<!-- stormworks-research-gap:mechanics:marine-propellers -->
This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/mechanics/marine-propellers).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Shipped-resource mechanics article**

> The small boat propeller receives engine power and its tooltip says it operates only underwater. The controllable-pitch boat propeller also requires underwater operation and takes desired pitch from -1 to 1. Its force_emitter_max_force field is 80000 versus 20000 for the selected small fixed-pitch propeller. These fields are configuration values and do not establish measured thrust or a speed-to-force equation.

- [wiki/data/mechanics.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/mechanics.json), `/articles/21/body`

**Shipped-resource mechanics article**

> No newtons, blade angle, cavitation, water-relative speed curve, stall behavior or propulsive efficiency is inferred from these fields or input ranges.

- [wiki/data/mechanics.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/mechanics.json), `/articles/21/limitations/2`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.
title: Underwater propellers and pitch control: resolve missing mechanics
